handoffs.message: Ready for review. Published TW-04 replay contract pack with dedicated replay list/detail routes, full replay-grade TeachingEvent schema, BFF-resolved evidence_link semantics, explicit commit/discard authority gating, and before/candidate/after artifact refs. Added canonical docs at docs/bff/TW-04-teaching-replay.md, docs/screens/TW-04-teaching-replay.md, and docs/examples/TW-04-teaching-replay.json; updated Trainer packet family, backlog, and frontend SA to contract-published pending-bff.

All three acceptance criteria pass. Replay routes, full TeachingEvent schema, BFF-resolved evidence links, and commit/discard authority model are all correctly specified. Returning to Codex for finalization.
